scope: read-only audit of onboard trial controller, its binary/configuration, and historical logs
joint_order: SDK FR, FL, RR, RL, each hip/thigh/calf; installed legacy adapter joint_ids_map is identity 0..11

raw_action.caveat: process_actions clips finite model output to +/-4.5 before storing raw in this installed policy; nonfinite original output throws before clipping

stiffness.caveat: installed candidate fixes kp=40, kd approximately1

stair_policy_checks.reaction: sets safety_stop_requested and records first cause; registered transition targets LieDown; protected CtrlFSM intercepts that transition and latches fixed damping, not the ordinary LieDown trajectory

publication_guard.position_checks: both measured q and proposed q; only for nonpassive command; lower/upper boundaries inclusive
publication_guard.velocity_mismatch: still uses former uniform training assumption; onboard/official URDF is hip/thigh30.1, calf15.7. Stair-policy measured-speed stop at13 normally fires first during Stairs.
publication_guard.effort_checks: abs(tau_ff)>limit or, for nonpassive commands, abs(estimated_PD_total)>limit; not actual measured motor torque; GuardInput has no tau_est
state_and_numeric_checks: tick advance no longer than0.1s gap
publication_guard.latch: first failure is immutable, no reset/rearm in process
publication_guard.damping_caveat: Fixed damping does not lock standing pose. Latched fallback bypasses normal estimated-total-torque checks; it does not guarantee actual damping torque remains within the above model effort limits.
nonlatched_damping: waiting for first observed source tick advance

handoff_and_stand_readiness.reaction: failed handoff gate refuses ownership; failed stand readiness prevents entering Stairs/resets readiness timer. These are not moving-policy speed limits.

verified_recent_trigger.later_diagnostic_caveat: GUARD_JOINT estimated torques from rejected transition proposal are not the initial cause or confirmed applied torque

conclusion: URDF limits, application stop thresholds, startup readiness thresholds, and firmware limits are distinct. Passing URDF speed limits alone does not pass current13rad/s policy stop. Training penalty removal does not remove runtime position/tracking/effort protections.
